summary: Bare Hill in Carver holds the Carver Fire Tower, an 80-foot steel tower built in 1988 and registered on the NHLR; the latest visit report is from 2014.

facts.design: 80-foot tubular steel tower with a slanted window cab and no door to the catwalk
facts.status_note: Latest visit report on the register is from March 2014; present condition not confirmed
facts.agency: Massachusetts Bureau of Forest Fire Control

access.note: State-run tower. The register notes no NHLR sign and no signed directions. No public visiting arrangement found in the sources read; a DCR post invited people to an event at the tower on a Sunday, July 28, to tour one of the agency's fire towers

corrections.why: The register gives the Carver tower on Bare Hill at N 41.857783, W 70.691400, about 2 km north of the Forest Lookouts point this record uses. Not checked against a map; the register figure is the more precise one

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register spells it Miles Standish State Forest. The DCR post and the Forest Fire Lookout Association post spell it Myles Standish, the state forest's name. The story uses Myles

notes_for_editor: Probable duplicate of us-ma-carver (Carver Fire Tower, NHLR US 733, same register entry on Bare Hill, built 1988). Record coordinates differ: this record 41.8407, -70.694 (Forest Lookouts) versus us-ma-carver 41.857783, -70.6914 (NHLR). Recommend merging the two records; not done here. Older-tower dates and location are unresolved: the register says 1918 and 1930 and gives SW Line Road, the Forest Fire Lookout Association post says 1919 and 1932 and gives Lower College Pond Road. Both are reported in the story. A 2017 Forest Fire Lookout Association post seen only as a search snippet gives the current tower as 85 feet; the post could not be read, so it is not used. The DCR post text read does not give a year. No photos added. No build permit, owner or current inspection source was found.
